semantics: Documentation graphs, not executable n8n workflows. Edges are process/data-flow compositions supported by references; planned edges are proposals.
title: Notifications & email automation
subtitle: Idempotent outbox, protected cron delivery and recorded notifications

nodes.label: Order / account event
nodes.description: Account verification, recovery, confirmed orders and shipping events trigger relevant mail routines.

nodes.label: Queue outbox message
nodes.description: Outbox IDs and existing-record checks prevent duplicate messages.

nodes.label: Protected mail cron
nodes.description: Bearer CRON_SECRET is required; no secret value is exported.

nodes.label: Cron authorization
nodes.description: Missing or incorrect bearer token is rejected.

nodes.label: Deliver pending outbox
nodes.description: Read pending messages, send and mark sent only after successful delivery.

nodes.label: Resend Emails HTTP API
nodes.description: Account and order mail HTTP integration; retries and failure status remain explicit. Runtime configuration and connectivity are Unverified.

nodes.label: Mark sent / record logs
nodes.description: Notification studio has notification_logs and deduplication; account events write account_notifications.

nodes.label: Notification and activity UI
nodes.description: Account activity reads notifications; admin notification studio reads delivery logs.

nodes.label: Request failed
nodes.description: Validation, access, conflict or service errors are returned to the caller. Status and error shape depend on the specific route.

nodes.label: Show error / retry
nodes.description: Failure end state. Caller receives the actual error; a retry may be offered by the UI.

notes: Source implementation is documented; deployed configuration and provider connectivity are not verified.
Outbox delivery and notification studio dispatch are related but separate service paths; not every outbox send creates a notification_logs entry.
